moments.text: The proposed response set out in full at appendices A responds directly to the options government is consulting on and assesses how well each proposal meets the government's published criteria, particularly around geography, deliverability, financial resilience, service quality, community engagement and support for devolution. The proposed response is consistent with the position this council has previously taken. It is the two unitary authority proposal. In summary, the response explains that two unitaries best balances the need for financial resilience and efficiency at sufficient scale, the ability to protect and sustain high quality statutory services, particularly adult social care, children's services and SEND, simple and more coherent strategic partnerships and support for economic growth across the county and the meaningful neighborhood engagements and local identity.
